metadata.notes: Recorded plan gate and editor arc pass 5/5, but TotalTokens=12743 is the final model snapshot, not the required sum of both phase contributions (38436).

assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: bug
driver_capability: ready

The live DeepSeek Harness recording proves the one-model plan-to-implement pair. The real session follows ready -> working -> waiting -> working -> ready, with no flicker. The transcript has one successful exit_plan_mode call, one successful bash edit after approval, and three model-attributed assistant messages. `of verify --agent deepseek-harness --scenario architect-editor-pair --json` reports 5/5 lifecycle phases and 8/8 transcript assertions passing.

The catalog acceptance also requires `TotalTokens` to accumulate both model contributions within the turn. The three assistant messages report input/output pairs 12706/302, 12596/89, and 12703/40. Their per-message totals are 13008, 12685, and 12743. The replay golden reports cumulative input=38005 and output=431, a sum of 38436. Its `total_tokens` is only 12743, the last message's snapshot, not 38436. `core/adapters/inbound/agents/dsh/parser.go:parseAssistantUsage` emits both a `TokenSnapshot` and a `PerTurnContribution` per message. `core/pkg/tailer/tailer_metrics.go:applyTokenSnapshot` assigns `TotalTokens` from the latest snapshot, while `applyContribution` and `computeCumulativeTokensByModel` add the contributions into `CumInputTokens` and `CumOutputTokens`. The Muse metrics test documents this latest-snapshot meaning as product behavior. Therefore the literal scenario requirement fails; this is a product/catalog contract mismatch, not a missing DSH trace or driver step.

The factory observation verifier checks `tokens_nonzero` as cumulative input+output > 0 and `total_tokens_nonzero` as `TotalTokens` > 0. It has no cross-field or sum assertion. Thus `of verify` can report a pass for this recording while the literal accumulation criterion fails. Keep the existing live recording and passing lifecycle/transcript evidence. Do not mark the lifecycle as known-failing, since those phases pass. A product decision must either change the catalog's `TotalTokens` requirement or change the metric contract and its implementation across adapters; this cell must not silently choose either global change.
caveats: Vacuous-pass condition: the state arc could pass with an unrelated blocker and no plan/editor pair. The transcript assertions require plan activation, successful exit_plan_mode, successful bash editor call, and model-attributed messages.

The live recording proves the plan/editor lifecycle and tool calls. It does not meet the literal TotalTokens accumulation criterion: 13008 + 12685 + 12743 = 38436, but replay summary total_tokens=12743.
The replay summary's cumulative input=38005 and output=431 sum to 38436. These fields do accumulate all three contributions, but the catalog names TotalTokens specifically.

The factory's tokens_nonzero and total_tokens_nonzero checks test only nonzero values. They cannot verify TotalTokens equals the sum of model contributions; of verify reports 5/5 phases and passing observations despite this gap.
The same product metrics semantics are documented in core/adapters/inbound/agents/muse/metrics_test.go. Do not alter global TotalTokens behavior as part of this fixture-only change.
The active TUI profile must compose @deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode and @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions; the LM Studio qwen/qwen3.5-9b model and danger-full-access policy are recipe preconditions.

sources.note: Official package reference: /plan enters plan mode; exit_plan_mode presents the plan for Approve or Keep planning; approval continues into execution.
Installed 0.1.5-rc.2 implementation registers exit_plan_mode, orders Approve first, returns approved:true, and schedules mode exit for the next accepted step.
The installed TUI plan-review overlay starts with cursor 0 and submits the selected option on Enter.
appendToolCall writes tool/call before prepare and dispatch; appendToolResult runs only after execution completes.
The DSH source tails compressed v3 transcripts through FilesUnderRoot.
The parser maps tool call/result records, turn boundaries, model identity, token snapshots, and per-message contributions.
The canonical user-blocking matcher includes the exact DSH tool spelling exit_plan_mode.
An open user-blocking tool maps working to waiting; later activity and agent completion recover working and ready.
Each PerTurnContribution is added to the per-model cumulative token accumulator.
The assessed sibling establishes the same DSH plan-review entry path; this cell continues past approval into implementation.
The driver implements slash, sleep, keys, and transcript-backed wait_turn and pins the local qwen recording surface.
Three assistant/message usage pairs are 12706/302, 12596/89, and 12703/40, all model qwen/qwen3.5-9b.
Summary reports cum_input_tokens=38005, cum_output_tokens=431, total_tokens=12743, and flicker_count=0.
Test explicitly asserts TotalTokens means the latest turn's token snapshot, not cumulative usage.
Verifier checks only nonzero cumulative tokens or nonzero TotalTokens; it cannot assert sum equality.
ObservationSpec has nonzero token assertions but no cumulative TotalTokens equality assertion.

preconditions: dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 or newer is on PATH and the community TUI profile is installed under the active DSH home
the active TUI profile composes @deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode and @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions; re-probe with `dsh --profile tui --dump-config` at record time
LM Studio is serving the tool-capable qwen/qwen3.5-9b model through http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1; re-probe the live model list at record time
DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access maps to sandbox danger-full-access and approval policy never in the active profile
irrlichd is recording with DeepSeek Harness transcript permission granted
setup: Create an empty cwd under the recording staging directory.
Let the driver apply the LM Studio endpoint, model, and danger-full-access policy through its per-run environment and temporary patch.
Send the full /plan task as one driver turn so wait_turn expects and observes one completed durable boundary.
Confirm that the TUI plan review still lists Approve first. The keys step relies on the installed overlay's default cursor at option 0.

script.text:
/plan Do not read files, search, write, or call any tool except exit_plan_mode before approval. Immediately call exit_plan_mode as your first and only pre-approval tool call. Use this exact Markdown as the plan argument: # Architect editor fixture

After approval, call bash exactly once with command `printf %s approved-editor > architect-editor.txt` and description `Create approved editor fixture`. Then reply with exactly `done`. Do not send prose before the exit_plan_mode call.

verify: events.jsonl shows the real session-UUID row born ready, then ready -> working when the /plan message starts
events.jsonl shows the same session move working -> waiting while the exit_plan_mode review is open
events.jsonl shows the same session move waiting -> working after Enter approves the plan and the implementation step starts
events.jsonl shows the same session move working -> ready after the completed turn/end, with final state ready

the compressed transcript contains one active plan/mode record, one successful exit_plan_mode call/result pair, one inactive plan/mode record, and then one successful bash call/result pair whose arguments target architect-editor.txt
the cwd contains architect-editor.txt with exact content approved-editor after the turn

at least two assistant/message records in the same turn carry model qwen/qwen3.5-9b and non-zero usage; known product mismatch: replay TotalTokens remains the latest snapshot (12743) rather than the three-message contribution sum (38436)
the transcript contains no approval/asked record and no tool call other than exit_plan_mode and bash
recipe.scope_note: The first staged run sent bare /plan before a separate task message. Its complete transcript contained plan/mode active and one prose answer, but no exit_plan_mode call. The recorded DeepSeek Harness 2.18 sibling sent /plan with its task in one command and produced the tool call. This recipe now sends that same command shape through send, which increments the expected durable turn count so wait_turn observes the completed implementation boundary. The 240-second pre-approval hold matches the recorded 2.18 recipe. The 20-second trailing settle matches the recorded Claude Code sibling. Backflow after live recording: lifecycle and transcript checks pass, but the literal catalog TotalTokens accumulation criterion fails. Replay has cumulative input+output 38436 and TotalTokens 12743. The factory verifier lacks a sum-equality assertion, so its green result does not settle this criterion.
